name: Mesh Remesher
author: Modly
description: Hole-free remeshing. SDF mode rebuilds a closed, all-quad skin with Blender's voxel remesher and bakes the source texture onto it (needs Blender; without it, Modly's own numpy remesher runs instead — triangles, no texture). Triangle/Quad-Dominant are pymeshlab routes with pre-cleaning, a hole guard and (with Blender) texture transfer.

params_schema.label: Mode
params_schema.tooltip: SDF rebuilds the surface as a closed, all-quad skin with Blender's voxel remesher (the output cannot tear; the source texture is baked onto it). Very thin features below one voxel get fused — raise the target count to keep them. Triangle produces a clean uniform triangulation; Quad-Dominant attempts more regular polygon flow. None passes the mesh through unchanged.

params_schema.label: Target Face Count
params_schema.tooltip: Desired face count of the remeshed skin. In SDF mode this is the quad count (the GLB stores two triangles per quad; the true quad mesh is also saved as *_quads.obj). The voxel size is solved from it in up to three tries. 0 = automatic (SDF keeps the input's density).

params_schema.label: SDF Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Built-in numpy SDF fallback only (ignored when Blender handles the SDF route): voxel grid subdivisions along the model's longest side. 0 = automatic from Target Face Count. 256 is slow and memory-hungry.

params_schema.label: SDF Smoothing
params_schema.tooltip: Built-in numpy SDF fallback only (ignored when Blender handles the SDF route): how much to relax the voxel staircase before projecting back onto the original surface.

params_schema.label: Target Edge Length
params_schema.tooltip: Triangle/Quad mode: target edge length in world units. 0 = automatic (keeps the input's sampling density, derived from surface area). Ignored in SDF mode.

params_schema.label: Quality
params_schema.tooltip: Triangle/Quad mode: remeshing passes. Draft (3) is fast but leaves jagged triangles; Standard (6) suits previews; Fine (10) converges to the most even triangulation. Ignored in SDF mode.

params_schema.label: Transfer Texture
params_schema.tooltip: Bake the input's base-colour texture onto the remeshed surface (needs Blender; skipped when the input has no texture). The GLB is triangulated by the format — the true quad mesh of the SDF route is saved beside it as *_quads.obj.

params_schema.label: Preserve Features
params_schema.tooltip: Triangle/Quad mode: keep sharp edges (creases above 30°) crisp while remeshing. Ignored in SDF mode.

params_schema.label: Weld Distance
params_schema.tooltip: Vertices closer than this are merged before remeshing, sealing the hairline cracks GLB exports leave along UV seams. 0 = automatic (0.1% of the model's diagonal). Applies to the numpy/pymeshlab routes and their pre-clean.

params_schema.label: Fill Holes
params_schema.tooltip: Close small holes before remeshing and after every destructive pass (numpy/pymeshlab routes). SDF mode always fills — its sign field needs a closed mesh, and closing holes is the point of this mode.

params_schema.label: Max Hole Size
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum number of boundary edges of a hole to be filled. Raise if holes remain open after remeshing.
